event_entry_type.description: Which of your entry types holds the events (Marvin has no built-in event type).

event_date.description: The date to count down to: one of their date fields, or a date every entry has (its scheduled publish or expiry date).

remind_at.description: The time of day the reminders are drafted, in the workspace's time zone.

draft_entry_type.description: The entry type the reminders are drafted as.
